description: Information about models and individuals from which biospecimen(s) were collected.

IndividualAgeatDiagnosis.description: Age at the time the individual was diagnosed, expressed in years.
IndividualAgeatDiagnosis.title: Individual Age at Diagnosis

IndividualDaysToRecurrence.description: Number of days between the date used for index and the date the patient's disease recurred
IndividualDaysToRecurrence.title: Individual Days To Recurrence

IndividualDaystoLastFollowup.description: Number of days between the dates used for index and last follow-up
IndividualDaystoLastFollowup.title: Individual Days to Last Followup

IndividualDaystoLastKnownDiseaseStatus.description: Time interval from the date of last follow up to the date of initial pathologic diagnosis, represented as a calculated number of days.
IndividualDaystoLastKnownDiseaseStatus.title: Individual Days to Last Known Disease Status

IndividualDaystoTreatment.description: Number of days between the date used for index and the date the treatment started.
IndividualDaystoTreatment.title: Individual Days to Treatment

IndividualDiseaseType.description: The type of tumor associated with the specimen. Multiple values permitted, comma separated.
IndividualDiseaseType.title: Individual Disease Type

IndividualGender.description: Text designations that identify gender. Gender is described as the assemblage of properties that distinguish people on the basis of their societal roles. Identification of gender is based upon self-report and may come from a form, questionnaire, interview, etc.
IndividualGender.title: Individual Gender

IndividualId.description: Unique row identifier, used as a primary key for record updates. This should follow the GrantNumber-INDxxx convention unless otherwise indicated.
IndividualId.title: Individual_id

IndividualKnownMetastasisSites.description: The text term(s) used to describe the anatomic site(s) of metastasis associated with the patient's malignant disease.
IndividualKnownMetastasisSites.title: Individual Known Metastasis Sites

IndividualLastKnownDiseaseStatus.description: Text term that describes the last known status of an individual.
IndividualLastKnownDiseaseStatus.title: Individual Last Known Disease Status

IndividualMetastasisStage.description: Extent of the distant metastasis for the cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined prior to treatment.
IndividualMetastasisStage.title: Individual Metastasis Stage

IndividualPrimaryDiagnosis.description: Text term used to describe the patient's histologic diagnosis, as described by the World Health Organization's (WHO) International Classification of Diseases for Oncology (ICD-O).
IndividualPrimaryDiagnosis.title: Individual Primary Diagnosis

IndividualPrimarySite.description: Primary site in the body associated with the primary diagnosis.
IndividualPrimarySite.title: Individual Primary Site

IndividualPrimaryTumorStage.description: Extent of the primary cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined prior to treatment.
IndividualPrimaryTumorStage.title: Individual Primary Tumor Stage

IndividualRecurrenceStatus.description: Yes/No/Unknown indicator to identify whether a patient has had a new tumor event after initial treatment.
IndividualRecurrenceStatus.title: Individual Recurrence Status

IndividualSex.description: Biological sex associated with the specimen donor
IndividualSex.title: Individual Sex

IndividualSiteofOrigin.description: The text term used to describe the anatomic site of origin, of the patient's malignant disease.
IndividualSiteofOrigin.title: Individual Site of Origin

IndividualTherapeuticAgent.description: Text identification of the individual agent(s) used as part of a treatment regimen.
IndividualTherapeuticAgent.title: Individual Therapeutic Agent

IndividualTreatmentResponse.description: Text term that describes the patient's final outcome after the treatment was administered.
IndividualTreatmentResponse.title: Individual Treatment Response

IndividualTreatmentType.description: Text term that describes the kind of treatment administered.
IndividualTreatmentType.title: Individual Treatment Type

IndividualTumorGrade.description: Numeric value to express the degree of abnormality of cancer cells, a measure of differentiation and aggressiveness.
IndividualTumorGrade.title: Individual Tumor Grade

IndividualTumorLymphNodeStage.description: Extent of the regional lymph node involvement for the cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined prior to treatment.
IndividualTumorLymphNodeStage.title: Individual Tumor Lymph Node Stage

IndividualTumorSubtype.description: The subtype related to the scientific determination and investigation, analysis and recognition of the presence and nature of disease, condition, or injury from expressed signs and symptoms of tissue growth resulting from uncontrolled cell proliferation.
IndividualTumorSubtype.title: Individual Tumor Subtype

IndividualVitalStatus.description: Text term that describes the patient's current vital status.
IndividualVitalStatus.title: Individual Vital Status

IndividualdbGaPSubjectId.description: The identifer assigned to the participant by dbGap
IndividualdbGaPSubjectId.title: Individual dbGaP Subject Id

StudyKey.description: The unique Study_id foreign keys associated with the resource, found in the grant Study information. Used to group the resource with other components. Please provide multiple values as a comma-separated list.
StudyKey.title: Study Key
